newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end 1.35 pct down on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end 1.35 pct down on blue chips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Wednesday as blue chips tumbled on speculative and foreign selling and dealers said they expected sentiment to remain negative due to a poor economic outlook.
The Karachi 100-share index fell 18.72 points, or 1.35 percent, to end at 1,362.91. Losers led gainers 140 to 82. PTCL fell 0.45 rupees to 31.25 and Hub Power 0.70 to 31.

"Hub Power fell on foreign selling, while the locals also took the lead," one dealer said. "There is little genuine interest and the market is likely to remain weak as the economic outlook is bad." -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
